column4: well that holds all memory and wisdom
spirit that quietly follows a person
Odin's raven Thought, flying the world
Odin's raven Memory, flying the world
world tree binding the nine realms
court poet who keeps the sagas
her thread leads out of the labyrinth
carries the world on his shoulders
the open market and meeting square
pottery shards used as ballots and notes
two faces watching door and passage
the scribe who writes it down
the workshop where things are made
island; an apartment block of old Rome
weight that keeps the ship steady
to make fast to a fixed point
the working kitchen of a ship
fire on a hill that signals
the surface that takes every blow
the strongest point of the wall
post house where fresh horses wait
the deep core of a shadow
the crown of light around the sun
the smell of rain on dry earth
the river that curves like thought
the book where every entry stays
the sundial's shadow-caster that tells time
the private language of a group
page written over but history shows
the maker's mark at the book's end
the opening words of a text
the meaningful gap in a manuscript
the range where a voice lives best
the race of many boats together
painting into wet plaster, no undo
the turn where the poem changes
the dark thrill great art gives
the place where you are strongest
a sign with intent sealed in
stones stacked to mark the way
where the river fans and deposits
one who flies the swift hunter
the turning line of the sun
the day the sun stands still
the star that keeps perfect time
the cloud where stars are born
when any move changes the game
frame that guides things as they grow
the shared table set for everyone
the first calculator, beads on rails
the ancient game of counting and sowing
the small blade that steers the whole ship
the dial that tells you the true state
where the sky is watched all night
